scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agent-workload-platform/journal-review-mcp build && pnpm run clean && tsc && node tool/package-journal-review-mcp.mjs
scripts.eval:classifier: pnpm run build && PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 PROMPTFOO_SELF_HOSTED=1 PROMPTFOO_SAFE_MODE=true promptfoo eval -c digital-twin/eval/promptfooconfig.mjs --no-share
scripts.eval:judge-calibration: pnpm run build && PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 PROMPTFOO_SELF_HOSTED=1 PROMPTFOO_SAFE_MODE=true promptfoo eval -c digital-twin/eval/judge-calibration.promptfooconfig.mjs --no-share
